title: Two-chart model of prime-power cosets and translation
statement: Let p be prime and a ≥ 1, put M = p^a, R = Z/MZ, H = Γ₀(M), Q = SL₂(Z)/H, and B = {z ∈ R : p divides z.val}, where z.val is the representative in [0,M). Let T = ((1,1),(0,1)), acting on Q by left multiplication. There exists a bijection e : Q ≃ R ⊔ B such that, for every t ∈ R, e(T⁻¹ · e⁻¹(inl t)) = inl(t+1), and for every z ∈ B there exists w ∈ B with e(T⁻¹ · e⁻¹(inr z)) = inr w and w = z(1+z)⁻¹. The inverse is the ZMod inverse, which agrees with unit inversion whenever its argument is a unit.
lean_statement: ∀ (p a : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → 1 ≤ a → let R := ZMod (p ^ a); let Q := (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ⧸ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 (p ^ a); ∃ e : Q ≃ (R ⊕ {z : R // p ∣ z.val}), (∀ t : R, e (ModularGroup.T⁻¹ • e.symm (Sum.inl t)) = Sum.inl (t + 1)) ∧ (∀ z : {z : R // p ∣ z.val}, ∃ w : {z : R // p ∣ z.val}, e (ModularGroup.T⁻¹ • e.symm (Sum.inr z)) = Sum.inr w ∧ w.1 = z.1 * (1 + z.1)⁻¹)
